digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Tuesday, August 11, with five meetings, one protected focus hour, two urgent items, and five carry-overs. The day turns on the 10:30 AM Jhara 1:1 and the 1:30-3:00 PM Maria and EPMO leadership sequence: rank the critical Court work, set the Legal Change Management and SMS path, and close the Latent Variables recommendation. Use the noon block to finish Jorge's sheet and make the weekly portfolio update decision-ready; the Colombia team check-in is the most immediate people priority.

items.label: Prioritize the critical Court work
items.detail: Use the 1:30 PM Maria 1:1 to rank hearing notifications and the Attorney Recommendation field, assign owners, and carry a clear sequence directly into the 2:00 PM EPMO team-lead catch-up.

items.label: Prepare the SMS scripts for the legal path
items.detail: Use the 10:30 AM Jhara 1:1 to confirm the Bucket 1 checkbox, Ariel and Legal review sequence, and how newly signed clients enter SMS Magic. Teams now places Legal Change Management near 35%, so clarify the remaining path before tomorrow's Legal sync.

items.label: Close the Latent Variables reply
items.detail: Sara told Hector that Jean, Danny, and Sara would review Jean's experience and recommendation today or tomorrow. Set the recommendation and reply while the external cohort spot is still being held.

items.label: Terminar Hoja de Jorge
items.detail: Use the protected noon hour to finish the sheet before the 2:00 PM EPMO team-lead catch-up.

items.label: Verify the Weekly Executive Report is current
items.detail: Sara shared the August 10 portfolio update overnight. Confirm the slides are dated August 10, reflect the latest programmatic changes, and are ready to support today's leadership discussion.

items.label: 8:00-10:30 AM - Open focus window
items.detail: Use the cleanest deep-work window to shape the Court ranking, Latent Variables recommendation, and any approval decisions before meetings begin.

items.label: 10:30-11:00 AM - 1:1 Jhara & Jean
items.detail: Review portfolio roadblocks and lock the Legal Change Management and SMS follow-through that needs a clear owner before tomorrow's sync.

items.label: 12:00-1:00 PM - Protected focus hour
items.detail: Finish Jorge's sheet and verify the weekly executive report. A 30-minute buffer remains before Maria's 1:1.

items.label: 1:30-3:00 PM - Maria and EPMO leadership sequence
items.detail: Maria's 1:1 flows directly into the EPMO team-lead catch-up. Enter with ranked Court priorities, owner gaps, and the few portfolio risks that need leadership action.

items.label: 3:30-4:00 PM - 1:1 Nicolas & Jean
items.detail: Use the afternoon close to confirm portfolio risks, dependencies, and ownership changes produced by the earlier leadership sequence.

items.label: Check in with the Colombia team
items.detail: Leadership asked managers to contact team members after the earthquake and confirm they are safe and supported. Do this early and escalate any immediate needs.

items.label: Submit the Spencer Huffman interview feedback
items.detail: Rippling requested Jean's Project Manager III interview feedback on Friday. Submit the assessment today so the hiring process is not waiting on an aging response.

items.label: Decide Andrew Hoke's Incidents Template access
items.detail: Review the SharePoint request for Incidents Template.docx and approve or decline it based on whether Andrew needs the document for the current incident-response work.

items.label: 10:00 AM - Salesforce and Legal collision
items.detail: The Salesforce Program Timeline Walkthrough and Legal Change Management sync occupy the same 30 minutes, followed immediately by Thiago and Sara 1:1s. Choose the live priority and arrange coverage today.

items.label: Noon-4:00 PM - Multiple protected-time conflicts
items.detail: The Legal repository walkthrough overlaps Blocked Space at noon; the EPMO team meeting overlaps Astrid at 2:30 PM; and the 3:00 PM operations events overlap Laura at 3:30 PM. Resolve attendance before the calendar stack starts.
